mapper.sql: id, merchant_id, submit_time, submit_data, audit_operator_id, audit_operator_name, audit_status, audit_remark, audit_time, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM merchant_audit_log WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_audit_log (id, merchant_id, submit_time, submit_data, audit_operator_id, audit_operator_name, audit_status, audit_remark, audit_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{merchantId}, #{submitTime}, #{submitData}, #{auditOperatorId}, #{auditOperatorName}, #{auditStatus}, #{auditRemark}, #{auditTime}, NOW(), NOW())
